scares.description: The glass vial cracks behind the boy
The glass vial explodes as the boy looks at it.
The nun's eyes glow up with a small sound.
Some viewers might be startled as the man turns his head abruptly.
"Save me sister" followed by the man's mouth opening to reveal sharp teeth.
The statue starts moving with a sound.
A short view of the nun's face appears.
A man suddenly opens the door.
"That's when it happened" followed by a flashback of the nun with a sound.
The camera zooms into the nun quickly with a sound and crows fly out.
Image from the magazines becomes the nun and she lunges to choke the woman.
A sound of a door banging.
Man turns around abruptly as hand is put on his shoulder.
"Mama" is heard whispered suddenly behind the woman.
A door tries to open on its own.
A figure runs past the camera in the dark. Can be considered major for some, but it's just a woosh sound with visual.
A rumble of sound is heard as rocks fall. Not particularly startling but it's in the middle of a very quiet and tense sequence.
Very minor with a light sound, a small boy is seen behind a pillar as the woman searches with the flashlight.
A chain is pulled across the ground past the woman suddenly.
Nun's fanged face comes out of the painting.
A crow flies past in the background.
"What the hell" followed by a demon looking at the camera and roaring.
A girl is pulled up into the air suddenly from the back of the group.
A woman's hands grab the girl as she says "She's standing in her room".
A man's hand grabs the platform the girl is on.
A man's hand grabs the woman's.
Man laughs in demon's voice and a bang is heard behind him.
Man appears in the crawlspace suddenly.
